# USGS WaterServices IV fixture provenance

These synthetic JSON fixtures reproduce the WaterML 1.1 JSON nesting documented for the
official USGS WaterServices Instantaneous Values endpoint. Site names, coordinates, values,
and query metadata are invented for deterministic tests; no live response or user data is
stored here.

The fixtures exercise valid provisional observations, the documented no-data sentinel, and
isolated malformed value rows.
